name: Reconciliation With God
overview: Scripture reveals reconciliation with God as a divine provision necessary for restoring fellowship between a holy God and sinful humanity. The Old Testament sacrificial system, exemplified by the purification of the altar with blood in Leviticus, foreshadows the ultimate reconciliation achieved through Christ’s atoning death, as Isaiah 53:5 describes His wounds bringing healing and peace. Daniel 9:24 foretells this reconciliation as part of God's plan to end sin and establish everlasting righteousness. Jesus emphasizes the priority of reconciliation in relationships, urging believers to be reconciled to others before offering gifts to God, underscoring reconciliation's foundational role in the believer's life.
